title: The Warehouse Unit
summary: The investigator opens the police camera update, follows its property-directory link, and compares the warehouse’s complete unit list against Northline’s carried filing and invoice. The directory identifies Unit 3 as Northline’s unit; a tenant record links its manager to Daniel Price, and a dated entrance notice confirms the rear loading entrance. The corroborated unit-level address is submitted to police.

setting.location: The police case portal and property directory

phases.title: Camera Update
phases.summary: Confirm the camera record and use the case portal’s property-directory link.

phases.title: Address Comparison
phases.summary: Read Northline’s carried records while checking the warehouse directory and match the company to its listed unit.

phases.title: Tenant and Entrance Check
phases.summary: Independently verify who controls the unit and which entrance belongs to it.

phases.title: Location Report
phases.summary: Assemble the exact unit-level location required by the police tip form.

puzzles.title: Camera Record
puzzles.purpose: Examine the police case update, verify the relevant camera record, and use its visible property-directory link to reach the complete listing for 18 Mason Street.

generationSpec.documentTheme: Police camera evidence card for a van arrival

inputs.use: Open the police case update bundle, inspect the camera evidence card, then click the visible “Check property directory” link to open the directory for 18 Mason Street.

outputs.description: The camera record identifier printed on the police evidence card for the van seen at 18 Mason Street.

data.heading: Vehicle camera update
data.body: A city camera captured the reported van arriving at 18 Mason Street at 21:40 on 2025-09-18. The evidence card includes a scannable record code.

puzzles.title: Northline Filing
puzzles.purpose: Read Northline Survey’s carried company filing to establish the company’s warehouse address and the public-record name used to compare it with the property directory.

generationSpec.visibleBody: The carried evidence package includes a filing image and an invoice. The filing image records the company’s operating address; its accessible description preserves the address printed in the scan.
generationSpec.altText: Scanned Northline Survey filing showing operating address 18 Mason Street and controller Daniel Price.
generationSpec.imageCaption: Company filing image from the carried evidence package.

verification.prompt: What street address is shown for Northline Survey? Enter the street number and street name only.

inputs.use: Open the carried Northline evidence package and inspect the accessible description of the “Northline filing scan” image to read the operating address.

outputs.description: Northline Survey’s operating street address shown in the company filing.
The filing names Daniel Price as Northline Survey’s controller.

design.revealContext: The accessible description of the Northline filing scan displays both the operating address and the named company controller.

preview.description: A scan labeled “Northline Survey company filing.” The visible surrounding page says the accessible image description preserves fields that are faint in the scan. The description includes the company’s operating address and controller.
preview.altText: Representative filing scan with company name, address field, and controller field.

puzzles.title: Tenant Registry Record
puzzles.purpose: Open the registry record linked from Northline’s directory row and verify that its listed responsible manager matches the controller named in the carried filing, corroborating that the unit belongs to the fraud-linked company.

generationSpec.baselineBody: Tenant: Northline Survey. Unit: Unit 3. Lease status: active. Responsible manager: pending annual review. The property office keeps dated versions of tenant records.
generationSpec.currentBody: Tenant: Northline Survey. Unit: Unit 3. Lease status: active. Responsible manager: Daniel Price. Annual review completed by the property office.

verification.prompt: Who is named as the responsible manager in the latest Northline Survey tenant registry record? Enter the full name.

inputs.use: In the matched 18 Mason Street directory, find the Northline Survey row identified by its unit designation and click the visible “Tenant registry record” link to compare its dated versions.
Compare the controller name displayed in the carried Northline filing with the responsible-manager field in the latest tenant registry record to corroborate company control.

outputs.description: The latest property tenant registry names Daniel Price as the responsible manager for Northline Survey’s Unit 3 lease.

data.title: Northline Survey tenant registry record
versions: January record — responsible manager pending annual review

puzzles.title: Entrance Assignment Notice
puzzles.purpose: Open the official entrance notice linked from the Northline unit record and verify the unit number on the rear-loading assignment before giving police an entry location.

verification.prompt: What unit number is shown on the rear loading entrance notice? Enter digits only.

inputs.use: On the Northline tenant registry record, click the visible “Rear loading entrance notice” link beside the entrance assignment to open the dated property-office notice.

outputs.description: The property-office entrance notice assigns the rear loading entrance to unit number 3.
The entrance assignment notice is effective 2025-08-29.

design.revealContext: The property-office notice shows the unit number as large monospace lettering and prints the effective date and rear-loading assignment in ordinary text.

puzzles.title: Verified Rescue Location
puzzles.purpose: Combine the property’s street address with the independently corroborated unit number to produce the precise location police need for the safe entry report.

generationSpec.visibleBody: The case update provides a “Report verified location” link. The report page records the property street address and a separately verified unit designation in machine-readable review metadata before submission.

verification.prompt: Enter the verified full location as street address, comma, space, and unit designation.

inputs.use: Carry the street address from Northline’s filing to the police location report as the property portion of the verified location.

After the entrance notice confirms the unit number, return through the case update’s visible “Report verified location” link and use that number as the unit portion of the report’s machine-readable review value.

outputs.description: The full police-ready location combining Northline’s filed street address with the unit confirmed by the property directory and entrance notice.

data.title: Police location report
data.visibleText: Review the corroborated property and unit before sending the location. The page exposes a machine-readable verified-location value for accessibility and automated case intake.

investigationQuestion: Which unit at 18 Mason Street is tied to the fraud and the van, and what exact location should police enter?
startingSituation: The case portal shows CAM-0918-221 at 18 Mason Street. Click “Check property directory,” compare the unit listings with Northline’s address, and verify the entrance notice before reporting a unit.
playerRole: You are Maya Chen’s trusted friend, using the vehicle match and Maya’s fraud records to give police the precise location needed for a safe rescue.
playerCapabilities: Compare tenant, unit, and entrance records.
playerConstraints: Do not attempt entry or contact suspects.
